title: Meta-rdk: Raw EEG data
description: Raw EEG recordings from 20 individuals with a schizophrenia spectrum disorder and 22 healthy control participants performing a random-dot motion discrimination task. After each left/right decision, participants rated their confidence on a visual analog scale. The dataset supports investigation of perceptual decision-making and metacognition in schizophrenia.
methods_description: Participants judged the motion direction (left or right) of 100 moving dots by reaching to and clicking one of two targets with a mouse. Motion coherence was adjusted individually with a 1up/2down staircase to match performance between groups. After each decision, participants reported confidence on a vertical visual analog scale from 0% (sure incorrect) to 100% (sure correct). Patients were diagnosed using the Structured Clinical Interview for DSM-5.
